brandStory.paragraph1: SILKinCOM was born in the heart of Europe's oldest silk district. Six centuries of textile know-how live in the hands of our masters — from the historic dye-houses of Cernobbio to the spinning mills of Bellagio, each step remains entrusted to those who know silk as a mother tongue.
brandStory.paragraph2: We select only noble fibres: Como silk, extra-fine cashmere, merino wool, European linen, extra-long staple cotton. We craft each piece one by one, with hand-finished hems, along the shores of the lake that has always inspired our aesthetic: discreet, timeless, profoundly Italian.

storia.quote: SILKinCOM is born from passion and experience in the Como textile world. A centuries-old tradition, reinterpreted with contemporary design and precious materials.
storia.storyP1: SILKinCOM was born in the heart of Como's silk district, where textile tradition meets innovation. After years of experience in dyehouses, printing mills, weavers and research laboratories, the brand transforms technical knowledge into a creative vision.
storia.storyP2: The aim is to give new life to Como's excellence through accessories in silk, cashmere and wool of absolute quality. Each piece carries the identity of a territory and the care of those who know it deeply.
storia.essenceP1: SILKinCOM exists to transform the Como textile heritage into contemporary accessories and garments in silk, cashmere and cotton. Every creation combines artisan mastery with modern design, with the goal of bringing to the world an authentic, elegant and timeless luxury.
storia.essenceP2: 100% Made in Como — from raw materials to final crafting, every phase takes place within the silk district, preserving the know-how of a tradition spanning centuries.
storia.liveDescription: Our story continues beyond these pages. Follow SILKinCOM on social media and let yourself be inspired by collections, details and impressions from the heart of Como.

faqs.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal. All payments are SSL encrypted and processed via Stripe.

faqs.q: Do prices include VAT and duties?
faqs.a: Prices displayed always include Italian VAT (22%). For non-EU orders, any customs duties and import taxes are at the recipient's expense, except for DDP shipments (UK, Switzerland, Norway) where duties are included.

faqs.q: How long does shipping take?
faqs.a: Italy: 2–4 working days. EU: 4–7 days. Rest of world: 7–12 days. All orders are tracked and insured. See Shipping for full details.

faqs.q: Can I return an item?
faqs.a: Yes, you have 14 days from receipt to return any unused item. Returns are free for orders within Italy. See Returns for the procedure.

faqs.q: How do I find the right size?
faqs.a: Every product page includes precise dimensions (e.g. 180×45 cm). For pashminas and scarves, standard sizes range from 180×35 cm to 200×70 cm. For shirts and t-shirts, contact us if you need assistance.

faqs.q: Are the products really Made in Italy?
faqs.a: Yes, every garment is entirely produced in Como — from spinning to final crafting. We work with the finest mills, dyehouses and ateliers of the oldest silk district in Europe.

faqs.q: How do I wash a cashmere scarf?
faqs.a: Hand wash in cold water with neutral cashmere detergent, never rub. Dry flat away from heat sources. See Garment Care for detailed instructions.

faqs.q: Can I modify or cancel an order?
faqs.a: You can modify or cancel an order within 2 hours of confirmation. After this window, the order enters production. Contact silkincom.business@gmail.com as soon as possible.

faqs.q: Do you offer gift wrapping?
faqs.a: Yes, every order includes elegant Maison gift wrapping at no extra charge. You can add a personalised note at checkout.

faqs.q: Do you have a loyalty programme?
faqs.a: We are working on an exclusive programme for our most loyal customers. Subscribe to the newsletter to be informed first.

faqs.q: How long has Como been the silk capital?
faqs.a: Como has been Europe's leading silk district since the 15th century. Como mills existed as early as 1400; today the area produces over 70% of silk and hosts the world's most prestigious luxury maisons.

faqs.q: Who founded SILKinCOM?
faqs.a: SILKinCOM was founded by Marco Dibenedetto, with operations based in Cermenate (Como). The maison was born to bring Como's textile heritage directly to the final customer, without intermediaries.

faqs.q: What does "Made in Como" mean?
faqs.a: Made in Como means every step — from spinning to weaving to printing to finishing — happens physically within the Como silk district. It is not just a label: it is a fully local supply chain.

faqs.q: Do you work with independent artisans?
faqs.a: Yes. We collaborate with independent weavers, printers and finishers in the Como district, many of whom pass the craft down through generations. Every piece bears the mark of the workshop that made it.

faqs.q: Do you have a showroom or visitable atelier?
faqs.a: Our atelier is in Cermenate (Como). Visits are by appointment — contact us by email to schedule a personalised meeting with our customer experience manager.

faqs.q: Where does your cashmere come from?
faqs.a: Our cashmere comes from the coldest regions of Central Asia (Inner Mongolia), where the fiber is finest (14-16 microns) due to the harsh climate. We select only the under-neck fleece, harvested by hand.

faqs.q: Is your silk really Italian?
faqs.a: Yes. The silk is spun, woven and finished in the Como district. Raw cocoons come mainly from China (Italy no longer produces raw silk since WWII), but all textile transformation is Italian.

faqs.q: What makes silk twill special?
faqs.a: Twill is a weave structure creating a visible diagonal on the fabric. Como silk twill is renowned for its weight (60-65g/m²), fluid hand and color stability — ideal for luxury scarves.

faqs.q: What is extra-long staple cotton?
faqs.a: Extra-long staple cotton (over 35mm fiber) is the most prized category: it produces finer, stronger and more lustrous yarns than standard cotton. We source it from Mediterranean and Egyptian growers.

faqs.q: Are your fabrics certified?
faqs.a: We work with OEKO-TEX Standard 100 certified suppliers, guaranteeing no harmful substances in finished fabrics. For Como silk we follow the Seri.co district standards.

faqs.q: What are SILKinCOM's standard scarf sizes?
faqs.a: Long scarf: 180×45 cm. Pashmina: 200×70 cm. Stole: 200×100 cm. Square scarf (carré): 90×90 cm. Twilly: 85×5 cm. Each product page specifies exact dimensions.

faqs.q: Do scarves shrink after washing?
faqs.a: No, if you follow the washing instructions. Cashmere and silk may lose 1-2% dimensional stability at first wash: always respect cold temperatures and specific detergents to avoid shrinkage.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size as a gift?
faqs.a: For a classic gift we recommend the long scarf 180×45 cm: versatile size, suitable for men and women. For a more refined gift, the 200×70 cm pashmina is a safe choice for those who love to wrap in warmth.

faqs.q: Do you make custom pieces?
faqs.a: Yes. Our Atelier service allows customisation of colours, sizes and finishes. Production time is 4-6 weeks. Visit the Atelier page for details and pricing.

faqs.q: Do you sell to hotels, restaurants or businesses?
faqs.a: Yes. We have a dedicated hospitality and corporate gifting channel with special terms for orders over 20 pieces. Contact us by email to request the B2B price list.

lanaItems: Hand-wash in cold water with a gentle detergent

cura.generalBody: Store your SILKinCOM accessories in a cool, dry place, away from direct light. For folded scarves and foulards, periodically alternate the folds to avoid permanent marks.
linoItems: Machine wash 30°C delicate cycle with neutral detergent
Alternatively hand wash in cold water
Dry flat or hang in shade without wringing
Iron hot while damp to bring out the fluid hand
cotoneItems: Machine wash 30-40°C with neutral detergent for natural fibers
Do not use bleach or harsh fabric softeners
Dry flat or hang; avoid high-heat tumble dry
Iron medium-high, on the reverse side for prints

materialiPage.description: Every SILKinCOM accessory is born from raw materials selected with extreme care. Silk, cashmere, wool, linen and cotton: five stories of absolute quality, from Lake Como to the world.

origine.label: Origin
origine.title: Como tradition
origine.body: Como silk has roots in the 15th century, when the first spinning mills made the city a global reference point. Today, this heritage translates into a supply chain that unites artisan mastery and contemporary innovation.

caratteristiche.label: Characteristics
caratteristiche.title: Naturally luminous
caratteristiche.body: Ultra-fine natural fibres that reflect light in a unique way. Silk is cool in summer and warm in winter, with an unmistakable softness.

beneficio.label: Benefit
beneficio.title: Elegance that caresses
beneficio.body: Hypoallergenic and breathable, silk is delicate on the skin and gives a feeling of luxury and comfort on every occasion. A material that elevates every detail with natural refinement.

origine.label: Origin
origine.title: Selection of the noblest fibres
origine.body: Cashmere comes from the ultra-fine fleece of goats raised in the coldest regions of the world. Only the finest fibres, hand-collected during the spring moult, are selected to guarantee a quality rooted in a millennia-old tradition.

caratteristiche.label: Characteristics
caratteristiche.title: Fineness and softness
caratteristiche.body: With ultra-fine fibres of 14–16 microns, cashmere is among the rarest and most precious yarns in the world. Warm yet light, enveloping yet breathable, it offers a unique tactile sensation.

beneficio.label: Benefit
beneficio.title: Warmth without weight
beneficio.body: Wearing cashmere means experiencing enveloping, natural and lasting comfort. A material that protects, warms and accompanies with elegance in every season.

origine.label: Origin
origine.title: Versatile and resilient
origine.body: Wool has accompanied humanity for millennia. From sheep raised in the purest regions comes a natural fibre that combines resistance and comfort, preserving its authenticity intact.

caratteristiche.label: Characteristics
caratteristiche.title: Naturally breathable
caratteristiche.body: Wool is warm, elastic and naturally breathable. Its structure allows for body temperature regulation, offering protection in every season.

beneficio.label: Benefit
beneficio.title: Natural comfort
beneficio.body: A fabric that envelops and protects, resistant over time and pleasant to wear. Wool represents the perfect balance between functionality and elegance.

linoOrigine.label: Linen — Origin
linoOrigine.title: Fibre of Mediterranean summer
linoOrigine.body: Linen comes from the Linum usitatissimum plant, cultivated for over 8000 years in the most fertile soils of Europe. An ancient fibre, symbol of purity and elegance, elected by Mediterranean culture as the textile par excellence of warm months.

cotoneOrigine.label: Cotton — Origin
cotoneOrigine.title: Extra-long selection
cotoneOrigine.body: Our cotton comes from the finest extra-long staple cultivations, where each filament measures over 35mm. A rare quality, hand-picked and selected to guarantee compactness, lustre and resistance superior to standard cotton.

caratteristiche.label: Characteristics
caratteristiche.title: Freshness and softness
caratteristiche.body: Linen's hollow fibres absorb up to 20% of their weight in moisture — a natural thermoregulator that stays cool to the touch. Extra-long cotton accompanies with a silk-like hand, lustre and exceptional colour rendering.

beneficio.label: Benefit
beneficio.title: Informal summer elegance
beneficio.body: Both antibacterial, hypoallergenic and biodegradable. Linen becomes softer with every wash, its creases tell of authenticity. Cotton ages with grace, ever more familiar on the skin. The perfect wardrobe for Italian summer.

hero.title: Our artisans
hero.subtitle: Weavers, printers and tailors of the Como district. Every SILKinCOM piece bears the signature of hands that have passed down their craft for generations.

weaving.title: From the Como loom to the foulard
weaving.description: Looms, threads and silk become scarves and foulards in the Como district: every step gives the piece its hand, drape and luminosity.

lorenzo.name: Paolo
lorenzo.alt: Paolo, SILKinCOM jacquard weaver, at the loom in the Como silk district
lorenzo.caption: Jacquard loom at work
lorenzo.story: He follows the rhythm of the jacquard loom, controlling weave, tension and thread alignment for silk scarves and foulards. He learned on the district's mechanical looms and today leads the Maison's weaving floor.

telaio.name: Adriano
telaio.alt: Adriano, SILKinCOM master dyer, at the silk dye baths
telaio.caption: Silk dyeing in progress
telaio.story: Prepares the dye baths, monitors water pH, doses the dyes by fibre and batch weight. Silk dyeing demands exact temperatures, times and immersion speeds: a few degrees of variation can shift the colour. Every batch is matched by eye against the reference swatch before finishing.

twill.name: Roberta
twill.alt: Roberta, SILKinCOM embroiderer, hand-stitching a monogram on a silk foulard
twill.caption: Hand embroidery in progress
twill.story: Hand-embroiders the details — logos, monograms, decorative motifs — on the silk foulards and scarves. Each stitch is set by eye with needle and silk thread matched to the fabric's weight. A custom monogram takes between 2 and 6 hours, depending on the complexity of the design.

recesso.condBody: The exercise of the right of withdrawal is subject to the following conditions, without prejudice to the mandatory rights granted to the consumer by the Consumer Code. The withdrawal must be exercised, on pain of forfeiture, within fourteen (14) days of delivery of the goods. The goods must be returned intact, in the same condition in which they were received, not used beyond what is strictly necessary to establish their nature, characteristics and functioning, and complete in all their parts, including tags, labels, seals, original packaging and any accessories and free gifts. Pursuant to Article 57(2) of Legislative Decree 206/2005, the consumer is liable for any diminished value of the goods resulting from handling other than what is necessary to establish their nature, characteristics and functioning; SILKinCOM therefore reserves the right to withhold from the refund an amount corresponding to such diminished value. The return is carried out at the customer's care and expense, and the customer must retain and provide suitable proof of shipment; the refund may be withheld until the goods are received or until evidence of return shipment is provided, whichever is earlier. Goods made to measure or clearly personalised, and sealed goods that have been opened after delivery for reasons of hygiene or health, are excluded from the right of withdrawal.
recesso.costiBody: The direct cost of returning the goods is borne by the customer. You return the goods at your own expense to the address provided in the instructions sent by email. Different rules apply to defective or non-conforming goods: in that case the return costs are borne by SILKinCOM (legal guarantee of conformity).

recesso.title: Right of Withdrawal
recesso.subtitle: Withdraw online · art. 54-bis Italian Consumer Code
recesso.intro: You have the right to withdraw from the contract within 14 days without giving any reason. The period starts from the day on which you, or a third party designated by you, receive the goods.
recesso.s1Body: Within 14 days of receiving your order (or the last item, for multiple shipments). You may also withdraw before delivery.
recesso.s2Body: Fill in the form below with your order number and the email used for the purchase. You will receive an acknowledgement of receipt by email with the date and time of the request.
recesso.s3Body: We will refund you within 14 days of your withdrawal notice, using the same payment method used for the purchase. We may withhold the refund until we receive the goods or proof of their return shipment.
recesso.s4Body: The right of withdrawal does not apply to custom-made or clearly personalised goods, nor to sealed goods opened after delivery for hygiene reasons.
